overview_description.description:
Raven (a trading name of Raven.GG Limited) are an esports apparel design and manufacturing company that launched in 2013. They specialise in the production of esports jerseys for individuals, teams and corporations of all sizes around the world. What makes us different than all the other jersey and esports apparel companies out there? The products they produce are one-of-a-kind and have been crafted for the perfect fit, quality and durability – all at an affordable price.

Not only do they offer top of the range jerseys, they are also a team of experienced designers who have worked with some of the biggest names in esports over the years including Impact, Prophecy, Quantic, Strictly Business, Nova, Flipsid3, Endpoint and many more. So if you’re looking to get your team some brand new esports jerseys or apparel, get in contact with us now.
